correctness_topical.explantion: Both Response a and Response b fail to provide any numeric estimate of how many Latinos have been misinformed about education, which is the core requirement of the query. Consequently, Response a demonstrates marginally better logical coherence.

coherence_stylistic.explantion: Response a maintains a uniform formal, academic tone throughout, with consistent complexity and voice. coverage_broad.explantion: Both responses suffer from the same fundamental shortcomings: they do not provide any numeric estimate of Latinos who have been misinformed about education, they fail to define what "misinformed" means, and they focus on peripheral educational statistics instead of the specific query.
